question: By whose grace has the determination of Kaula been known?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
The Kaula determination is now known
inference: The speaker has come to know the Kaula determination through the lord of Kaulas' grace.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
